title: SDLC authored artifact
description: Validate the metadata and level-two sections projected from one authored Markdown artifact. Review fields record claims only.

sections.description: Keys are exact level-two heading text. Values contain section bodies. Additional sections are permitted.

stableId.description: Stable local or namespaced identifier without whitespace.

reviewTimestamp.description: ISO date-time with explicit timezone. Calendar validation requires an enabled date-time format checker.

review.description: Recorded business review. These fields do not authenticate the reviewer or establish approval authority.

writingReview.description: Automated writing checks and the recorded complete ASD review have separate states.

metadata.description: The authoring envelope identifies document form and maturity. It is separate from governed Workbench knowledge records.

sectionBody.description: A required section needs content. Explain each not applicable section. Semantic lint checks placeholders and structured content.
